dataset.description: The dataset contains an example of experimental and theoretical studies related to radiation defects in dielectric materials.

distribution.title: Revision of existing experimental studies: This section includes a review and analysis of previous experimental studies related to radiation defects in dielectric materials. The objective is to digitize the published results and use advanced chemical kinetics methods to treat the annealing kinetics of defects by studying the concentration decay with heating and extracting parameters such as diffusion coefficients of mobile defects (interstitial).
